name: extract multiple typed fields from repeating HTML elements using CSS selectors
definition: Select repeated container elements and pull out several sub-fields (text values) from child elements identified by class selectors, casting to the correct types.
failure_mode: Selectors miss/extract wrong elements or fields cast to wrong types, corrupting records.

name: extract structured profile facts from plain-text documents
definition: scan multiple provided plain-text documents with regular expressions to pull identity and background values such as names and contact details.
failure_mode: empty or noisy extraction yields wrong or missing mappings.
